title: Avro Lancaster LL686
memorial_details: description: IN GRATEFUL MEMORY OF THE GALLANT CREW OF THE LANCASTER BOMBER OF/ 432 SQUADRON, ROYAL CANADIAN AIR FORCE, BASED AT EASTMOOR, WHICH CRASHED/ NEAR ALDBOROUGH ON THE EVENING OF 2ND FEBRUARY 1944./ THEIR AIRCRAFT, ON A CROSS-COUNTRY TRAINING FLIGHT, HAD CAUGHT FIRE/ AND WAS LOSING HEIGHT WHEN THE PILOT, WITH GREATER SKILL, MANAGED TO/ AVOID THE VILLAGE AND INSTEAD CAME DOWN ON STUDFORTH HILL,/ A SHORT DISTANCE TO THE SOUTH./ THE CREW WERE/ (Names)/ THIS MEMORIAL WAS ERECTED BY THE VILLAGERS OF THE ALDBOROUGH TO/ COMMEMORATED THE 50TH ANNIVERSARY OF THEIR NOBLE SACRIFICE/ 1994
